public_rationale: SimpleQA tests short, fact-seeking questions with one checkable answer (e1). OpenAI's own usage study covers mid-2024 to mid-2025, a span that includes the post. In it, the broader 'Seeking Information' topic was 14% of conversations in mid-2024 and 24% a year later (e2, e3). Practical guidance and writing were as large or larger. Even the wide 'Asking' category, which includes advice, was 49% of messages (e4). So short factual lookups like SimpleQA's were well under half of ChatGPT usage, as Zitron said.
limitations: Topic shares come from a news report on the paper, because the full PDF could not be fetched.
The study covers consumer plans only.
Zitron's point that SimpleQA is therefore not useful is commentary and is not scored.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative usage data from the target period shows that short factual lookups make up a majority of ChatGPT messages or conversations.
